visualReview.realism: Convincing skin, lip texture, small irregularities and individual hair strands; pore/shine slightly more polished than the Sunburst precedent.
visualReview.identity: Visually coherent with current frontal anchor; half-face cannot establish full face proportion metrics.
visualReview.fragmento: One eye visible in V2/V3, but model introduced a vertical foreground obstruction on the right despite explicit prohibition in V3. Not a pure crop at the frame edge.
visualReview.accent: V1 rectangular label too prominent; V2 restrained; V3 marker/bokeh enlarged again.
visualReview.signatureBed: V3 white contrast 5.42:1; no signature composited for this raw model proof.
visualReview.fullValidator: V3 3/4; field at margin FAIL. No headline/collaborative reservations declared. Full gate not claimed PASS.
visualReview.comparison: Historical Sunburst F6 has cleaner edge crop and more candid quality; Nano gives higher native resolution and convincing close-up material. Current identity references and compiled blocks differ, so not a controlled A/B.
